what: codemem v2 file walk + chunking (no embedding) over vllm-project/vllm, one run
chunk_seconds_note: includes a second parse of every file to count parse errors; chunking alone is roughly 2/3 of this
cuda_note: tree-sitter-cpp does not know CUDA syntax (__global__, kernel<<<...>>>). Blanking CUDA-only tokens with spaces before parsing cuts files with parse errors from 212 to 157 of 327 C/C++/CUDA files but recovers only 3 more functions (4118 -> 4121), because tree-sitter's error recovery already keeps nearly every function. Not adopted.
